actual_cards.name: Deadly Recluse
actual_cards.oracle_text:
Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.)
Deathtouch (Any amount of damage this deals to a creature is enough to destroy it.)
actual_cards.provenance: Scryfall metadata mirror (METADATA_ONLY; 1/2). Chosen as the minimal deathtouch blocker: 1 power is enough for deathtouch-lethal. No simpler deathtouch body needed.

candidate_reference_provenance: OFFICIAL_RULES_DERIVED: constructed from Oracle reminder text; no candidate output consulted.
expected_rules_events: DAMAGE simultaneously: Bear deals 2 to Recluse (lethal, toughness 2); Recluse deals 1 deathtouch-lethal to Bear
SBA: BOTH creatures destroyed (deathtouch 1 damage is lethal; 2 damage >= 2 toughness)

expected_terminal_assertions.assertion: Bear and Recluse both in graveyards

external_decision_script.chosen_option: pass to damage; single-blocker assignment automatic

notes: Deathtouch-lethal isolation (single blocker, no ordering decision by design). Adaptable to 2 players.

reverses: COMBAT: 1 deathtouch damage must count as lethal in mutual-destruction SBA (falsifies toughness-only lethal checks)

title: Deathtouch blocker mutual destruction
